card.text: The smallest planet and the closest to the Sun.

introduction.text: Mercury's cratered surface can reach 430 °C by day and drop to −180 °C at night.

normal.title: MDIS Global Basemap BDR
normal.summary: Grayscale brightness at 750 nm, which changes with the surface and the lighting of each image.

enhanced.title: MDIS Enhanced Color Mosaic
enhanced.summary: Colors separate surface materials; missing polar color is filled from nearby imagery.

topography.title: MDIS Color Shaded Relief
topography.summary: Colors show elevation and shading shows slopes, not the planet's visible color.

interior.title: Interior structure model
interior.summary: A large metallic core inside a rocky shell, sized by the structural model.
